messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Neural networks on Rhadoop
parts: The only analytical offering based on RHadoop that I am aware of is muHPC by muSigma, not free. Of course you can build your own and that's the main goal of rmr2, to enable such development, but there isn't any advanced analytics built in, by design.
